_comment: Starter template for a single-doc-type custom analyzer. Copy to .local_only/schemas/<name>_v1.json, replace placeholders, then run create_and_test.py. See SKILL.md Step 2 for the baseAnalyzerId table and field-description rules.
description: REPLACE: one-line description of what this analyzer extracts.

exampleScalarField.description: REPLACE: value printed after the 'EXAMPLE LABEL:' anchor near the top of the page. Reference text anchors (labels, headings), not visual appearance.

exampleDateField.description: REPLACE: date printed after the 'DATE:' label. Not to be confused with other dates such as a due date or service date.

exampleAmountField.description: REPLACE: amount on the row labelled 'TOTAL' in the totals table at the bottom. Excludes any 'Subtotal' or 'Previous Balance' values.

exampleArrayField.description: REPLACE: each row of the line-items table.

itemCode.description: REPLACE: value in the ITEM CODE column.

description.description: REPLACE: value in the DESCRIPTION column.

amount.description: REPLACE: value in the AMOUNT column.
